# Katsura–Kondō–Shimada characteristic-five data

*On the supersingular K3 surface in characteristic 5 with Artin invariant 1*,
Michigan Math. J. 63 (2014), 803–844: DOI `10.1307/mmj/1417799227`, arXiv 1312.0687.
[Official data page](https://home.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/ichiro-shimada/ComputationData.html).

`GramSX` has rank 22. Published `walls[i]`, `SAutXD[i]` and `TAutXD[i]`
describe three induced chambers and their period-preserving groups.
**`Aut_X(D_i)` must not be substituted for the full lattice stabilizer
`Aut(D_i)`.** Further reported chamber counts do not supply complete wall data.
